# superset_css_template (Data Source)

Looks up a CSS template by its name. The lookup fails when no template has exactly that name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_css_template" "dark_header" {
  template_name = "Dark header"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `template_name` (String) Name of the template. The comparison is exact.

### Read-Only

- `css` (String) The stylesheet.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the template.
